title: Authentic Aromatic Italian Pork Lasagna
description: A traditional Italian dish featuring layers of pasta, pork, and cheese, cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, halal friendly and made with cultured creme fraiche.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer, letting it cook for a few minutes until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine the creme fraiche, parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper, mixing until smooth.
Grease the ttukbaegi earthenware pot with olive oil and begin building the lasagna by spreading a layer of the tomato sauce on the bottom.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, followed by a layer of the pork mixture, a sprinkle of mozzarella cheese, and a spoonful of the creme fraiche mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Cover the pot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
